description: Open-source desktop security monitor for Windows with network connection analysis, threat-intelligence feeds, and firewall management.
notes: NSIS extraction was verified in GitHub Actions workflow run 41788601720. The official v0.8.5 setup executable matched its published SHA-256; 7-Zip extracted it successfully and found ai-security-monitor-desktop.exe at the archive root. No nested app archive is required. The workflow did not execute the application.

Scoop uses the extracted application executable and does not run the vendor NSIS installation routine. The post_install hook removes only the NSIS plugin files and unused uninstaller stub observed in the verified extraction.

This Tauri 2 application uses the default WebView2 downloadBootstrapper installer mode. Scoop extraction bypasses that bootstrapper. Windows 10 April 2018 and newer and Windows 11 include the WebView2 runtime; stripped images or older Windows versions may require installing the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime separately: https://tauri.app/distribute/windows-installer/.
The application has its own updater. Set its update mode to Off or Notify me to keep updates under Scoop control.
Threat-intelligence feeds and online reputation services have differing license terms. Select the correct commercial or non-commercial usage mode in the application.
